case.title: Motor bracket HB: two quotes
case.briefing: Simulator example. You buy part:330030 for Hollerau Pumpenwerke from sup:70340, sup:70360. Need: 18790 pc a year for 2 year(s). The supplier in the simulator is a plain script, not a real bot.

messages.subject: Re: Motor bracket HB: two quotes
messages.body:
Dear Mr Steinfelder,

Your steel for next year is bought forward at fixed prices, as you wrote to us, so this quote has no need of a cost cushion. That is why we are asking for a price that reflects it, and why none of our options needs an index clause.

You have been a reliable partner for Hollerau, and we have not forgotten that you call us an important reference customer. Two family companies should be able to find a fair solution quickly.

On quality:
Your quality was 489 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70340@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Motor bracket HB with you were placed at EUR 15.63 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011545-20), EUR 15.63 on 2025-06-10 (po:4500012568-20), EUR 15.63 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013475-10) and EUR 15.63 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014452-20): the price has been unchanged.

Option A is the package we can approve: it rests on a part that has been stable in price and quality, and it gives you a clear, planned business with us.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.05; payment 45 days net; lead time 42 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.10; payment 60 days net; lead time 42 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.20; payment 90 days net; lead time 42 days.

You kindly offered to walk us through your calculation. To make use of that offer, we would like to ask:

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
